items:
.4 Miles to Beach, Family Vacation Home Near 30A, Sleeps 12 ~ Sandy Bottoms at Ivy at Inlet Beach

Sandy Bottoms is a beautifully designed coastal home tucked inside the Ivy at Inlet Beach, a thoughtfully planned community that feels calm, intentional, and quietly special. It's the kind of place families choose when they want the best of 30A without the congestion. You're close to Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, but far enough removed to avoid the traffic, crowds, and constant hustle.

Days here tend to unfold easily. Bike rides to the beach in the morning. Coffee runs, long walks, or time spent exploring along Scenic 30A in the afternoon. When the day winds down, you come back to a home that feels genuinely comfortable. Rinse off in the outdoor shower, fire up the grill, gather on the balcony, and settle into a space that feels clean, relaxed, and welcoming.

Sandy Bottoms is for guests who appreciate quality without excess. It's a smart location choice, a comfortable home base, and a place that lets your vacation feel effortless rather than overproduced.

TOP HIGHLIGHTS
• Located in the Ivy at Inlet Beach community
• Walk or bike to Inlet Beach access
• Sleeps up to 12 guests comfortably
• Two-story home with two separate living areas
• Six bikes included
• Two paddle boards with life vests included
• Beach gear included with chairs, umbrella, and beach cart
• Smart TVs throughout the home
• Private outdoor shower with hot and cold water
• Balcony seating and outdoor dining area
• Natural gas grill
• Fast Wi-Fi
• Full-size washer and dryer
• Pack 'N Play provided
• Onsite parking for up to three small vehicles
• No street parking permitted

LAYOUT + BATHROOMS
Sandy Bottoms is a two-story home designed with flexibility in mind for families and larger groups.
• Primary suite is located on the first floor and features an en suite bathroom with a walk-in shower
• Two guest bedrooms upstairs share a full bathroom with a large shower
• Two living areas allow guests to spread out and enjoy their own space

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS | SLEEPS 12
• Primary Suite, First Floor: King bed, Smart TV, en suite bathroom with walk-in shower
• Bedroom Two, Second Floor: Queen bed, Smart TV, shared bathroom
• Bedroom Three, Second Floor: Queen bed, Smart TV, shared bathroom
• Loft Area, Second Floor: Two twin-over-twin bunk beds with twin trundle, queen Murphy bed, Smart TV, and mini fridge

KITCHEN + DINING
The full kitchen is available for guest use and well suited for shared meals, quick breakfasts, or easy dinners at home. Enjoy outdoor dining on the balcony and make use of the natural gas grill for relaxed evenings in. If you'd like assistance with grill readiness, our concierge team can help coordinate in advance.

COMMUNITY / AREA NOTES
Sandy Bottoms is located in the Ivy at Inlet Beach, a quiet residential community just minutes from some of the area's most loved destinations. Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and 30Avenue are all close by, offering dining, coffee shops, boutiques, and easy access to Scenic 30A. The location makes it easy to explore during the day and retreat to a calmer setting in the evening.

CHECK-IN + ARRIVAL
Smart-lock self check-in is provided for a smooth arrival. Arrival details, access instructions, parking information, and community notes are shared after the required rental agreement is completed.
• Check-in: After 4:00 PM
• Check-out: By 10:00 AM
• Early arrival or late departure may be available upon request for an additional fee

DOORSTEP BEACH GEAR DELIVERY
For stays of two nights or more, guests will receive information after booking to access optional doorstep beach gear delivery through VayKLife. This service allows you to select additional chairs, umbrellas, cruisers, coolers, and other beach essentials for delivery to the home, with easy pickup after your stay.

GETTING AROUND
Many guests choose to walk or bike to the beach and nearby spots using the included bikes. A car is recommended for exploring Destin, Pier Park, and other surrounding areas. Rideshare services such as Uber and Lyft are available.

HOUSE RULES + BOOKING REQUIREMENTS
• Primary reservation holder must be 25 years of age or older and remain onsite for the duration of the stay
• No pets permitted
• No smoking or vaping anywhere on the property
• No parties or events
• Registered guests only; occupancy must match the reservation
• Signed Coastline Condos rental agreement is required to finalize booking
• Guests must follow all community rules, including quiet hours and parking regulations
• Parking is limited to designated spaces only
• Street parking is not permitted and may result in towing or fines
• Exterior security devices may be present for safety and occupancy compliance

OTHER NOTES
High-speed Wi-Fi is provided. Guests who rely on uninterrupted connectivity may wish to bring a personal hotspot as backup. Seasonal or winter extended stays may include additional cleaning fees. Coastline Condos does not have access to residential mailboxes, and package deliveries should be arranged through a carrier pickup location. Please report any maintenance or housekeeping concerns promptly so our local team can assist.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
